name: Maria R.
text: She explained everything calmly. I left with a written plan and the peace of mind of knowing exactly what I needed and what it would cost.
quote: Calm, clear explanation and a real plan.

name: Carlos G.
text: I've lived in Asunción for three years and couldn't find a dentist who spoke English. Dra. GP understood me perfectly and gave me clear options.

name: Andrea V.
text: I was told I needed a crown and she showed me a restoration would be enough. She saved me money and preserved my tooth.

name: John D.
text: Clear communication, written plan, no pressure. Exactly what I needed after a bad experience elsewhere.
